text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Per Curren Chan's request, I set aside 
time for a yoga lesson.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, it starts with meditation, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *sigh*... ...*phew*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems quite fired up. Let's just 
quietly watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*boom-cha, boom-cha*♪)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that sound...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoo! Time to keep the party going after 
five~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Maruzen-san?! This place is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Curren-chan, enjoy the stage too! 
A TGIF dance party has gotta be totally 
hyped up, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hawa, a dance party... TGIF...?

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-chan, you're so cute! Looking 
fine! Super fab~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No way. Everyone's eyes are sparkling. 
They're looking at Maruzen-san and saying 
she's cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Could the world's definition of cute 
have changed without Curren knowing...?!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fluff, fluff, flup, flup♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, Maruzen-san. Can Curren dance with you 
too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the music just made me so 
excited♪ Umm, was it called... the podium?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You have wonderful eyes. Burning with 
ravenous hunger... They're so hot they 
might just fire me up, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aah. Maruzen just felt a spark! I'll give 
them a treat... with groovy dance moves 
and rad lingo...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fluffy-fluffy-fluff~♪ Now it's completely 
hunky-dory, right!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What?! It's super groovy!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Everyone! Let's party until morning 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Nnh... Huh? Where's Maruzen-san...? 
Where's the podium?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...A dream? But for a dream, it was so 
novel, like another world altogether――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I tapped into an uncharted realm of 
cute!! Curren definitely got way cuter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's eyes sparkled brightly— From 
that day on, her cuteness and sharpness 
grew even more polished!
